accountEmailAddress.title: accountEmailAddress
accountEmailAddress.description: The email address of the sender, Typically this is the custom field named - Account_mail_Id__c as email address.

generatedEmailDraft.title: generatedEmailDraft
generatedEmailDraft.description: The email draft that the prompt template generated

opportunityId.title: opportunityId
opportunityId.description: The Salesforce Opportunity record Id for which the email draft should be generated. Use the Opportunity from the current record context or from a Get Records action.

opportunityName.title: opportunityName
opportunityName.description: The Opportunity Name used for personalization within the email draft.

receiverEmail.title: receiverEmail
receiverEmail.description: The email address of the intended recipient of the draft email. Typically this is the Primary Contact email address.
